title: OpenMetrics endpoint is unreachable

definition.name: [KrakenD] Integration OpenMetrics Endpoint is unreachable
definition.message:
The KrakenD integration cannot reach the OpenMetrics endpoint `{{endpoint.name}}`.

This can be due to an issue with the KrakenD configuration. For more information about how to configure the KrakenD integration check the [configuration guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/kuma/#configuration).

description: The KrakenD integration cannot connect with the OpenMetrics endpoint specified in the integration configuration
